title: Enable HTTP requests before Expense Agent setup
summary: The Expense Agent extension now enables HTTP client requests when the setup wizard opens, allowing service communication before full setup completion.
key_points: HTTP client allowance is set when the setup wizard initializes
The setting change runs as a try function to prevent setup blocking on failure
The allowance is applied before the first service probe for better flow
The allowance persists for all subsequent agent operations
quote: Enable HTTP client requests for the Expense Agent extension when the setup wizard opens.
